title: fix(swarm): stop deleting teams and task lists when the CLI process exits

files.patch:
@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@ All notable changes to DreamCoder will be documented in this file.
 
 - Dev mode (`bun run electron:dev`) finds the bundled ripgrep, so Glob and Grep work without a system `rg` on `PATH`. `bun run build:sidecars` now writes `desktop/binaries/<target>/dreamcoder-sidecar` and `rg`, the same names as the packaged app; run it once more in an existing checkout and delete the old suffixed files in `desktop/binaries/` (#195). Thanks @pcbeingused333.
 - A forced tool (`tool_choice` of type `tool`) from an Anthropic client is now sent to OpenAI Responses providers in the Responses shape (`{ type: 'function', name }`), so the request no longer fails with a 400 (#212). Thanks @pcbeingused333.
+- Stopping or restarting a lead session no longer deletes its team and task list (#199). Teams are removed only by `TeamDelete`, not when the CLI process exits (Stop, `/clear`, restart, app quit). Thanks @pcbeingused333.
 
 ## [0.8.0-beta.2] — 2026-10-29

+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'bun:test'
+import * as fs from 'node:fs/promises'
+import * as os from 'node:os'
+import * as path from 'node:path'
+import { getSessionCreatedTeams } from '../bootstrap/state.js'
+import { runCleanupFunctions } from '../utils/cleanupRegistry.js'
+import { init } from './init.js'
+
+const configDirAtLoad = process.env.DREAMCODER_CONFIG_DIR
+const apiKeyAtLoad = process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
+let tmpDir: string
+
+const exists = (p: string) =>
+  fs.access(p).then(
+    () => true,
+    () => false,
+  )
+
+beforeEach(async () => {
+  tmpDir = await fs.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'team-shutdown-'))
+  process.env.DREAMCODER_CONFIG_DIR = tmpDir
+  process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = 'test-key'
+})
+
+afterEach(async () => {
+  getSessionCreatedTeams().clear()
+  process.env.DREAMCODER_CONFIG_DIR = configDirAtLoad
+  if (apiKeyAtLoad === undefined) delete process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
+  else process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = apiKeyAtLoad
+  await fs.rm(tmpDir, { recursive: true, force: true })
+})
+
+describe('shutdown', () => {
+  it('keeps a session team and its task list on disk', async () => {
+    const teamDir = path.join(tmpDir, 'teams', 'crew')
+    const taskDir = path.join(tmpDir, 'tasks', 'crew')
+    await fs.mkdir(teamDir, { recursive: true })
+    await fs.mkdir(taskDir, { recursive: true })
+    await fs.writeFile(path.join(teamDir, 'config.json'), JSON.stringify({ name: 'crew', members: [] }))
+    await fs.writeFile(path.join(taskDir, '1.json'), '{}')
+    getSessionCreatedTeams().add('crew')
+
+    await init()
+    await runCleanupFunctions()
+
+    expect(await exists(path.join(teamDir, 'config.json'))).toBe(true)
+    expect(await exists(path.join(taskDir, '1.json'))).toBe(true)
+  })
+})
